name: @gjsify/gl-runtime-win32-x64
description: Optional OpenGL implementation for the Windows x64 GTK runtime — Mesa's WGL build (opengl32.dll + libgallium_wgl.dll) that @gjsify/node-gi preloads on a host with no OpenGL driver of its own (VMs, RDP sessions, CI), so Gtk.GLArea and GSK's GL renderer work there. Opt in by adding it as a dependency. Platform-gated (win32/x64 only).
